title: Hubble: An LLM-Driven Agentic Framework for Safe, Diverse, and Reproducible Alpha Factor Discovery
central_strategy: A constrained LLM generates AST-safe formulaic factors from positive/negative RAG, deterministic evaluation scores them on RankIC, Pearson IC, long-short return, turnover, coverage, complexity, and similarity, and family-aware selection fixes a top-five range/volatility/trend factor set for held-out U.S. evaluation.

required_but_missing: The five winning formulas, exact hyperparameters, candidate identities, signs, and family-selection records.
The operator registry/executor, prompts, positive/negative RAG corpora and indexes, model requests/responses, and scoring constants.
Frozen U.S. universe/data snapshots, included-date arrays, missing-data rules, and formula values.
Candidate/error records, seeds, runtime environment, raw IC/return/turnover arrays, and persisted diagnostics.
A transaction-cost-aware investable portfolio rule; v2 reports simple factor diagnostics without costs.
monthly_jkp_assessment.intentional_withholding: The v2 paper explicitly withholds the exact top-five formulas and hyperparameters, so range/volatility/trend family labels cannot identify executable scores.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_family_proxy_is_not_hubble: Choosing a generic range, volatility, or trend factor from JKP would manufacture a formula and bypass Hubble's defining constrained generation and family-aware selection.
monthly_jkp_assessment.chronology_problem: The two named v2 LLM backends became public after the claimed OOS window began, contradicting a literal pre-OOS formula freeze absent timestamped prompts/formulas/artifacts.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_sandbox_component_is_insufficient: The local AST fixture validates conditional safe execution only and has no released Hubble candidate identity, data, score, selection, or paper-result lineage.

closure_rule: Do not infer formulas from family labels or plot heights, promote the AST fixture, or choose a favorable generic technical factor. Reopen for the top-five formulas or an attributable generation/evaluation artifact release.
